verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises earning up to 3.89% yield through Treasury by Mercury Advisory alongside its checking and savings accounts. Its API supports internal transfers between depository and treasury/investment accounts within the same organization, and exposes treasury transactions and statements, so yield is earned without leaving the Mercury platform. Missing for 10: detail on how the yield works (product composition, eligibility, the conditions behind 'up to', custody), whether operating balances earn yield automatically or need manual moves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
